messages.author: 2b2a7dccb793ae6c
messages.subject: Warning with inverse gamma distribution
parts:
I don't understand the warning I get with the following script (j0, jmax are constant)
Can someone help explain? Thanks!

--------------------------script
parameters{
    real <lower= 0, upper= 1> p_jit;
    real <lower=0> jit_alpha;
    real <lower=0> jit_beta;
}

transformed parameters{
    real jit;
    jit <- j0 * exp( p_jit * log((j0+jmax)/j0) - 1 ); 
}

model{
    jit ~ inv_gamma(jit_alpha, jit_beta);
}

-----------------------output

DIAGNOSTIC(S) FROM PARSER:

Warning (non-fatal):

Left-hand side of sampling statement (~) may contain a non-linear transform of a parameter or local variable.

If so, you need to call increment_log_prob() with the log absolute determinant of the Jacobian of the transform.

Left-hand-side of sampling statement:

    jitter ~ inv_gamma(...)

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Warning with inverse gamma distribution
parts:
If you transform parameters

(p_jit, jit_alpha, jit_beta) -->

--> (jit, jit_alpha, jit_beta)

you have to take the Jacobian of the transform into account
to get the right distribution back on the original parameters.

The manual has examples.

- Bob
